fact: Following Cabinet approval, the AfCFTA Protocol on Digital Trade was being submitted to Parliament for ratification, the Select Committee being briefed on 20 October 2026; it is not yet ratified.
title: South Africa's Ratification of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) Protocol on Digital Trade and South Africa's Ratification of the SADC Protocol on Industry
publisher: Department of Trade, Industry and Competition (presentation to the Select Committee on Economic Development and Trade)
